businesses.business: radiation detection, measurement and monitoring equipment

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures radiation detection, measurement, monitoring and analysis instruments, plus dosimetry services and radiation therapy quality assurance products. Sells to nuclear power plants, defense agencies, medical providers, laboratories and industrial customers worldwide.

primary_products.value: radiation detectors and monitors; personal dosimeters; nuclear reactor instrumentation; radiation therapy quality assurance systems; radiological identification and survey instruments

primary_services.value: dosimetry services; calibration, maintenance and repair; software and monitoring support

customer_segment.value: B2B: nuclear power operators, hospitals and cancer centers, laboratories, industrial and research firms; B2G: defense, homeland security and emergency response agencies, government nuclear facilities

end_markets.value: nuclear power; defense and security; medical radiation therapy and diagnostics; industrial and laboratory; research

revenue_model.value: product sales: detection, monitoring and dosimetry instruments and systems; service fees: dosimetry subscriptions, calibration, repair and maintenance; project or contract: nuclear plant instrumentation and systems projects
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds detectors and instruments from purchased components, sold to utilities, hospitals, governments and industry; service provider: provides dosimetry and calibration services to radiation workers and facilities

specialization.value: related lines: nuclear and safety, medical, and laboratory radiation measurement lines sharing technology and customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving utilities, hospitals, and governments; distributors / dealers: regional distributors and representatives

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: products support nuclear and radiation safety compliance, subject to NRC, export controls and medical device rules
